versions.changelog: Episodes now show as bookmarked when their series is on your watchlist (e.g. the newest episode in "Latest" on the home screen). Clicking the bookmark there opens the series.
Fix: the plugin page in the dashboard now shows the logo and the correct version again.

New: Watchlist now speaks 19 languages and follows the display language set in Jellyfin (French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Czech, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more). English remains the fallback.
New: "Watch later" now has an Anime group. Movies and series from a library whose name contains "anime" (e.g. "Anime", "Anime-Movie") are shown there instead of under Movies/Series.
Fix: the Watchlist tab was missing after going back to the home screen from a library page (only came back after reloading the page).

Overview ('All') now shows only the 8 most recently added items per category (per Movies/Series group in Watch later) in a single scrollable row, like the Favorites rows. 'Show all' opens the full category.

New built-in default category 'Watch later' (always there, cannot be renamed or deleted, name follows the UI language). Inside it, items are split into collapsible Movies / Series groups based on the item type (series, seasons and episodes count as Series). Existing 'Watch later' / 'Später ansehen' categories become the default automatically.
Modern layout (default in Jellyfin 12): Watchlist link right after Favorites in the top bar and in the side menu. The watchlist can also be opened directly via #/home?tab=2.

Fixed the Watchlist tab not loading (error 't is not a function'). Colors now follow the Jellyfin theme (Light, Apple TV and all other built-in themes). Fixed the watchlist staying visible next to Home in the legacy layout. Last German text in the category manager translated.
Renamed from Merkliste to Watchlist, English UI (German when Jellyfin is set to German), plugin icon, installable from a plugin repository.

name: Watchlist
description: Adds a Watchlist tab next to Home and Favorites on the home screen and a bookmark button next to every favorite heart (movies, series, seasons, episodes). Organize what you still want to watch in your own categories. Every user has their own list. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Your personal watchlist with categories, right on the home screen
